hashContract.jsonValue: UTF-8 JSON.stringify after recursively sorting object keys; array order and strings preserved; no Unicode normalization

sequences.rationale: Personal vocabulary and sein/haben support listening/speaking introductions. Reading invitation/reply adds social meeting context; writing introduces Marco and invites Thomas to Friday lunch.

sequences.titleVi: Di chuyển và ghi thông tin chuyến đi
sequences.rationale: Travel words and questions recur across train messages, ticket dialogues and bus directions. The form reuses personal-data vocabulary from S1 while transferring explicit trip facts.

P0.description: Alphabet and spelling, greetings, numbers 0–100, days/time basics; adult early-A1 learner screening and support, not an absolute-beginner first lesson.

P1-SOCIAL.description: Recognize birthday/party/family and invitation chunks: am Samstag, um 15 Uhr, kommen, mitbringen, Bruder/Schwester, Geschenk, Kuchen.

P1-LISTENING.description: Support seit + Wochen/Monaten, country names, occupations and im Büro nebenan; no claim these were taught by only 12 vocabulary items.

P2-TRAVEL.description: Recognize 24-hour times, prices, Gleis, möchten/müssen chunks, hin und zurück, links/geradeaus, selected separable-verb phrases and a supported falls clause.

P2-FORM.description: Personal-data labels, total persons, months including August, number of days, invented traveller facts rather than real learner PII.

reviewSchedule.withinSequence: Split vocabulary/grammar into small chunks; move to reading/listening, supported speaking, then writing. Do not force six skills into one session.
reviewSchedule.retention: Short recall after session plus a delayed task around day seven; learner study not started.
reviewSchedule.humanReviewRequirement: Read every selected unit and shared context, listen to every required audio, resolve gaps and review the exact revised hashes. No automatic promotion from source cefrAudit.aligned.
